theme_strategy.login_page: High-energy marketing layout with secure, rigid fintech login components. Orange-to-red gradient top bar and promo area over a clean white lower section.
theme_strategy.dashboard: Clean, authoritative banking dashboard. White background with sky-blue accents. Task-first layout with clean cards and soft shadows.

headings.usage: Used for all page titles, card headers, and prominent marketing copy on the login page.

body.usage: Used for all data tables, sidebars, buttons, and secondary text.

rules: Use tabular nums for all financial data (balances, transaction amounts) to ensure numbers align vertically.
Login promo heading should use large display text (text-4xl to 5xl).
Dashboard headings should remain moderate (text-2xl maximum for page titles).

login_page.structure: Split horizontal marketing layout. Top 40% uses the orange-to-red gradient for nav/promo. Bottom 60% uses off-white.
login_page.bento_grid: Above the form, use a overlapping grid of quick-access cards (icon + label) that spans across the gradient-to-white intersection to bridge the two sections.

dashboard.structure: Fixed left sidebar (240px, white theme) + Top search/nav bar + Scrollable main content area.
dashboard.overview: Top section features a prominent two-option tab toggle. Followed by 6 stat cards in a responsive grid.
dashboard.lists: Use a 2-column grid for features/settings: 'icon + label + chevron' row format in white cards.

components.sidebar: White background. Grouped sections (Core / Coins & Financials / System). Active items get a soft sky-blue background (`bg-sky-50`), bold sky-blue text, and a right border accent. Inactive items are slate-500.
components.buttons: All primary actions (save, create, submit, quick-actions) MUST be rounded 'pill' buttons (`rounded-full`) in sky-blue (`bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-600 text-white`).
components.tabs: Prominent two-option tab toggle near the top of Overview. Use a pill-shaped container (`rounded-full p-1 bg-slate-100`), where the active tab gets a white background + shadow, or sky-blue fill.
components.tables: Clean white cards. Soft shadows. No vertical cell borders. Horizontal borders only (`border-b border-slate-100`). Header rows should use uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs text-slate-500.
components.cards: Dashboard stat cards must be white, `rounded-2xl`, with subtle slate-200 borders and soft shadows.
components.badges: Status badges must stick strictly to green (ACTIVE/COMPLETED), amber (PENDING), and red (FAILED/SUSPENDED).

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-[2px] transition-transform duration-200 on stat cards and quick access cards.
motion.buttons: scale-[0.98] active state for pill buttons. Smooth background color transitions (`transition-colors`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the sky-blue primary button has at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use text-slate-900 for primary text to ensure readability against white/slate-50 backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: Keep ALL existing `data-testid` attributes exactly as-is. Do not remove or alter them. This is absolutely critical for the application's automated testing suite.

crown_logo.description: Silver crown logo to be used as a placeholder for ROYAL11 branding on the login page and sidebar.

login_background_reference.description: Abstract orange-red gradient reference. Use CSS gradients (from-orange-500 to-rose-600) primarily, but this can be used as a texture overlay if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a VISUAL RE-SKIN ONLY. Do not alter routing, state logic, role checks, or existing data structures.
Preserve ALL `data-testid` attributes. This is critical for tests.
Implement the 'Outfit' font for headers and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body/tables. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.

Login Page: Build a custom top navigation bar with the orange-to-red gradient. Underneath, a promo text section using the same gradient or matching solid background. Below that, build a grid of 3-4 quick access icon+label cards that visually overlap the transition between the colored top area and the white form area.
Dashboard: Change the main wrapper background to `bg-slate-50`. Update the sidebar to a clean white background with `sky-50` active states.
Convert all primary buttons to pill shapes (`rounded-full`) using `bg-sky-500`.
Tables should be housed in white cards (`bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm`) with generous padding (`p-6`).
Ensure the tab toggle on the Overview page uses a pill-shaped container.
Update lists (like Managers, Admins, API Keys settings) to use the 2-column icon+label+chevron row grid inside white cards.
Change status badges to strict Green/Amber/Red logic only.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Use targeted transitions (`transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Never center align the main app container. Maintain natural left-aligned reading flows for data.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use Lucide icons (already installed) or similar professional SVGs.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Dashboard cells need breathing room.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use solid white or blurred white (`bg-white/90 backdrop-blur`).
Ensure all interactive elements have hover and active states.
